messages:
sylvie: FYI scheduling a quick narrow-wave at 04:10 UTC to roll runtime 2.14.1 + router header rename. Plan: router -> runtime header name change with a 10m dual-key shim. Need cross-service pin for api/runtime/router/console, start with 5% canary then ramp. Expect ~25m total.
ash: Copy. Can we do router+runtime canary first, then api/console? avoids double blast.
sylvie: Yeah that's the ask. Sequence: canary(router,runtime)=5% -> monitor 6m -> ramp api/console to 10%. Pin 40m for safety.
taylor: Paste deploy command so I can run the presubmit smoke locally and queue deploy-bot.
sylvie: Command I plan to run:
```
deploy-bot start-wave --id=narrow-12 --seq=router:canary,runtime:canary;api,console --pin=40m --traffic=5/10
```
ash: Rollback plan? Which metrics to watch?
sylvie: Rollback if api 5xx >0.8% absolute OR router->runtime header parse errors >3 in 2m, or p90 latency +200ms over baseline for 5m. Rollback command:
```
deploy-bot rollback --wave=narrow-12 --target=previous --note="header-parse-fail"
```
deploy-bot: wave narrow-12 queued for 04:10 UTC. Notifying oncall and owners.
sre-bot: monitoring preflight checklist posted: https://internal/runbooks/narrow-waves. Alerts: router_header_parse_errors, svc_5xx_rate, p90_latency. Thresholds included.
taylor: Running presubmit smoke now. Will post results.
taylor: presubmit: smoke passed locally, small flake in one integration test but unrelated.
deploy-bot: beginning canary phase: router,runtime -> 5% traffic. Monitoring window 6m.
sylvie: Canary live. Watching logs.
ash: saw one header_parse_error at t+3m from router logs, count=1. investigating.
taylor: also seeing a single API 500 tied to header deserialization in a rare code path (null value).
sylvie: Hmm. We added a shim to send both keys; why null? can you paste stack?
ash: stack: java.lang.NullPointerException at HeaderParser.parse(HeaderParser.java:78) -> shows code path not handling empty header value.
sylvie: That appears to be an edge case when header present but empty. Not caught by shim. Recommend abort and rollback to be safe.
taylor: I agree; aborting. I'll trigger rollback and open a follow-up fix.
deploy-bot: aborting wave narrow-12. Initiating rollback to previous pinned versions.
sylvie: Rollback in progress. Confirming traffic shift back.
deploy-bot: rollback complete. Services back to previous stable versions. Pins cleared for narrow-12.
sre-bot: Post-rollback steps: run full smoke suite (started), keep enhanced logging for header parser for 60m.
taylor: smoke suite passed in post-rollback run. No residual errors.
sylvie: Thanks. I'll create ticket INF-4381 to add null/empty header guard and add unit + integration tests, then re-run canary only for router+runtime once green. Will reschedule narrow-12 for later this week.
ash: Also suggest temporarily making router emit header metadata about presence/empty so we can detect early in future.
sylvie: Good idea; adding to the ticket. Thanks all.
